change.summary: Layer-driven action references and JavaFX menu presentation.
change.description: Adds FxActionRef, ActionLayerReader and LayerMenuBuilder, so menus can be assembled from the action references the nbfx annotations write under NbFx/Menus, NbFx/Toolbars and NbFx/ContextMenus instead of hard-coded id lists. The API is under development until the MVP freeze.

ViewProvider now extends Lookup.Provider and adds a default getLookup() returning Lookup.EMPTY, so the active view's lookup can be published as the global action context (the nbfx replacement for the activated TopComponent's lookup). Existing implementations are unaffected; the default is empty.

EditorDocument now extends Lookup.Provider and adds a default getLookup() carrying the document and its file, so the active editor's lookup can be published as the global action context (the nbfx replacement for the editor TopComponent's lookup). Existing implementations are unaffected.

change.summary: FileSelectionContext keeps only the navigator focus signal.
change.description: Removes FileSelectionContext.selectedFiles() and setSelectedFiles(List). The navigator selection is now published by each navigator through its own ViewProvider.getLookup(), since the global action context follows the active component; only the navigator-focused signal, which is shell state rather than selection, remains. Under development until the MVP freeze.

head.title: Change History for the NetBeansFX API

body.p: This document lists changes made to the NetBeansFX API.
